description.value:
You fire an omni-tool beam that siphons kinetic barrier energy directly from a target and transfers it to your own shields.

Choose a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-tech-energy-drain] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[electricity]] damage, or loses 10 shield HP if it has an active kinetic shield.

Failure Against a shielded target: drain up to 20 HP of shields; you gain that amount as temp HP (stacking with existing shields, up to your maximum). Against an unshielded target: @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d8[electricity]] damage and you regain 10 temp HP.

Critical Failure As failure, but drain 40 shield HP (or 4d8 electricity) and you gain 20 temp HP from the drain.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
